summary: Library supports preserving core E-Rate program and asks FCC to avoid changes that would reduce access, increase administrative burden, or limit local flexibility for libraries, patrons, and communities The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, citing concerns about administrative burden and local flexibility for libraries, patrons, and communities. The comment cites the FCC's NPRM in WC Docket Nos. 26-133, 13-184, 21-93 and FCC 26-41 (rel. June 26, 2026).

claims.argument: Preserving core E-Rate program avoids reducing access and increasing administrative burden
